title: peak.yaml
description: What a repo is, what owns what, and what to read first, for people and coding agents. Spec: https://github.com/bergaaberg/peak/blob/main/SPEC.md

version.description: The format version. Leave it out or write 1.

name.description: The project's name, as people say it.

description.description: One sentence on what it is.

url.description: Where it runs or is published.

tier.description: How much care the repo gets. active: worked on now, changes go through review and CI. maintained: kept working, changes are small and careful. scratch: experiments, anything goes. Other words are allowed. Default: active.

components.description: The parts of the repo, each with the paths it owns.

owns.description: Paths or globs, relative to the repo root (e.g. src/web/, packages/db/**).

rules.description: A repo-relative file with the rules for working in this component.

docs.description: What to read first: label → repo-relative path (e.g. architecture: ARCHITECTURE.md).

health.description: What a dashboard should watch for this repo.

workers.description: Names of deployed services (e.g. Cloudflare Workers).
